summary: This is an environment configuration file that sets up variables for a Joomla 4 website running in Docker containers with a MySQL database. It defines database credentials, admin user information, software versions, and port mappings that the application will use when it starts up.

explanations.2: CONTAINER_PREFIX is a label used to name the Docker containers so they're easy to identify and reference as a group.
explanations.15: MYSQL_PORT specifies which network port the database server will listen on; 3302 is chosen instead of the default 3306 to avoid conflicts if another MySQL is running.
explanations.21: WEB_PORT is the port on your computer where you'll access the Joomla website in your browser—so you'd visit something like http://localhost:8082 to see it.
